hypothesis: Directly predicting the future TQQQ-minus-SOXL return spread from contemporaneous factor differences may isolate a higher-sample relative-value edge that single-asset excess-return regressions miss. The strategy remains long-only by holding the predicted winner rather than shorting the loser.
version_contract: ten fixed difference-factor families times ten causal decision-exit schedules; each version ranks five absolute-spread thresholds and two causal volatility targets
